title: finding(plugin-timeline): `TimelineRenderer` spreads every unnamed prop onto its root element, so a `plugin-timeline:timeline` node renders `items="[object Object]"` into the DOM
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` public door, measured once: a `plugin-timeline:timeline` node rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer` + registry draws its authored keys as stringified attributes on the root element. Reader: the `domain:ui` seat #1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560), which dispatches it once triage grades it. Filed by that seat, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, from the objectui#6170 dev report `5859191910` (PR objectui#10840). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (objectui `origin/main`, read by this seat)

`packages/plugin-timeline/src/renderer.tsx`:
- `:1242` `export const TimelineRenderer = ({ schema, className, ...props }: { … [key: string]: any })` collects every prop it does not name into `props`;
- `:1344`, `:1351`, `:1372` and `:1532` spread `{...props}` onto the root element of each variant branch (`Timeline`, the grouped vertical `div`, `TimelineHorizontal`, `TimelineGantt`).

## Measured (by the objectui#6170 dev, a real `SchemaRenderer` + registry, one key varied at a time)

- On `plugin-timeline:timeline`, authored node keys reach `TimelineRenderer` as leftover props and land as root-element attributes. The probe's first diff shows `items="[object Object]"` and `variant="vertical"`. Before PR objectui#10840, `orientation`, `position` and `events` also landed there.
- The bare `timeline` route (through `ObjectTimeline`) does not leak.

So an author's schema ends up serialized into the page's DOM, where React flags it for unknown props, and a stringified array lands as an HTML attribute value.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Stop spreading unnamed props onto DOM elements. Either forward only a named, DOM-safe set (for example `data-*`, `id`, `style`), or drop the spread. Re-read what the `plugin-timeline:timeline` registration passes as props before choosing, and pin the root element's attributes for one authored node.

## Dedupe

REST listing of the 800 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #10266), grepped locally:
- `[object Object]` → 7 hits, none a carrier;
- `leftover props` / `...props` → 8 hits, none about the timeline renderer;
- `TimelineRenderer` with attribute / spread / DOM → 1 hit, PR objectui#10840, the reporting dev's own PR;
- `React does not recognize` → 0.

Lit control: `TimelineRenderer` alone → 8 hits.

Dedupe words: `TimelineRenderer leftover props DOM attributes` · `timeline items [object Object]` · `plugin-timeline:timeline props spread root element`
